# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure and stooping shoulders. He has long iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders and wears a full, soft brown beard that he has had since age twenty. When traveling, he occasionally dresses up in a white collar and his best suit.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is an extraordinarily shy and silent man who hates going among strangers or places where he might have to talk. He dreads women and young girls, fearing they are secretly laughing at him, though he feels comfortable with Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Despite his quiet nature, he is deeply sympathetic, soft-hearted, and possesses an amazing silent persistency when he sets his mind on something. He enjoys listening to talkative people who do not expect him to keep up his end of the conversation.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

## Goals

- Adopt a young boy to assist with farm work at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- Keep and care for Anne Shirley at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert, a lifelong resident of Green Gables in Avonlea, decided with his sister Marilla to adopt a native-born orphan boy to help with farm work as he grew older. He drove to Bright River station to collect the child, only to discover a mistake had been made and a young girl named Anne Shirley had been sent instead. Unable to leave her at the station, he brought her home and immediately grew fond of her talkative and imaginative nature. Though Marilla initially insisted on returning Anne, Matthew quietly advocated for keeping her, realizing they could be a good influence on the child. Throughout her upbringing, Matthew constantly indulged Anne, secretly buying her sweeties, defending her against harsh punishments, and encouraging her romantic spirit. When Anne wished for a fashionable dress with puffed sleeves, Matthew braved his intense shyness to purchase the materials and had Mrs. Lynde make it as a Christmas gift. He took great pride in Anne's academic achievements, encouraging her to study for the Entrance Examinations and eventually for Queen's Academy. Though he suffered from worsening heart trouble, he continued working the farm until he unexpectedly passed away from a sudden heart attack after reading news of the failure of the Abbey Bank.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 c12 P43](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0043), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c32 P46](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0046), [v1 c36 P39](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0039), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_
